title: EPC Account Manager
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**EPC Account Manager**

As an EPC Account Manager, you will drive strategic growth and achieving the AOP targets across a defined portfolio of (EPC) accounts in the southern region. The EPCs represent a high\-priority growth segment for our organization, and this role is important to reshaping our engagement model through an outcome\-based approach and unique value propositions. Also, would focus on Large Project Pursuits with complexity handling, program management, drive value strategy , create attachments and build large deals.


You will report to the National Sales Leader End User\-Process \& Heavy and work onsite in Chennai, India.


**Your Responsibilities**

* Manage and deliver AOP targets for assigned EPC accounts in the region.
* Leadership for Large Project Pursuits **:** Take ownership of large project pursuits by anchoring the role of program manager, ensuring seamless coordination across stakeholders and departments. Promote execution excellence with successful outcomes.
* Lead strategic selling initiatives on Digital, Cyber, AI with a balance of assertiveness and consultative engagement.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with internal teams including end\-user, OEM, domain experts, industry and operations to lead account success.
* Develop and articulate compelling value propositions tailored to EPC customer needs.
* Build and Experience establishing communication and engagement with prospects with important partners across EPC organisations. CXO connects.
* Champion customer\-centric strategies and lead from the front in high\-impact engagements.
* Identify growth opportunities and lead account expansion through solutions.
* Drive Secure Digital Operation building through EPCs.
* Out of the box thinking, deep customer insights and relate those intelligence to our initiatives for delivering customer\-centric outcomes .

**The Essentials \- You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
* Knowledge of automation systems, control solutions, and digital transformation technologies. Industry Knowledge: Oil \& Gas, Heavy Industries, Semiconductor, Data Centre, Infrastructure.
* Experience managing complex accounts and large\-scale projects.
* Challenge status quo, break the mould and do things differently

**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:**

* Engineering professional with at least 12 years of Sales experience in strategic sales or account management within the EPC large process OEMs.
* Understanding of manufacturing trends, industrial automation technologies (like Automation and controls, Motion, Drives, Safety products), and customer business drivers in End User segments.
* Work on assigned accounts and aligned actions with business goals.
* Familiarity with IT/OT convergence, industrial automation platforms, and digital tools like CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) or data analytics platforms.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …


* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

title: Consultant
description:
You’re an excellent candidate for Bizzdesign because you …* Live in Chennai and can commute to the office 2\-3 days per week
* Communicate fluently in English and can confidently lead customer workshops, explain technical concepts, and engage senior stakeholders
* Have \+5 years of relevant experience in technology\-enabled consulting or enterprise SaaS delivery, ideally within Business Process Management or Enterprise Architecture

  

  

**About the role**  

  

In this role, you will help enterprise customers turn strategy into execution using the Bizzdesign Solution Suite.  

  

As a Professional Services Consultant, you’ll combine functional expertise with a hands\-on mindset to guide customers through their transformation journey and ensure long\-term success.  

  

You will be part of our global Professional Services team, working closely with internal teams to continuously improve delivery quality and customer experience.  

  

**What will you do**
* Deliver expert consultancy, training, and strategic guidance to large enterprise customers
* Lead business and technical engagements, from onboarding through implementation and rollout
* Partner closely with customer stakeholders to ensure success and solve critical challenges
* Manage projects end\-to\-end, meeting deadlines and proactively mitigating risks
* Contribute to defining and improving best practices to strengthen customer experience and delivery quality
* Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Success, Technical Support, Product Development and Sales to support shared customer outcomes
* Support customers across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas

  

  

**What we are looking for**
* \+ 5 years of experience in technology\-enabled consulting, delivering value to enterprise clients
* Background in Business Process Management, Enterprise Architecture, SaaS Business Consulting, or related fields
* Strong presentation and communication skills in English, able to lead customer sessions confidently
* Proven ability to drive customer value, adoption, and retention with internal and external stakeholders
* Problem\-solving mindset, proactive attitude, and ability to work well in ambiguous environments
* Familiarity with modeling languages such as ArchiMate, UML, BPMN (a plus)
* Proven willingness to learn scripting languages to continuously improve the solutions you deliver
* Flexibility to travel occasionally to customer sites (primarily within the Netherlands)

  

  

**What we offer**
* A competitive salary complemented by variable compensation.
* Company\-sponsored Provident Fund and Gratuity benefits in line with local regulations.
* 15 vacation days during your first two years, 20 vacation days in years three and four, and 25 vacation days from your fifth year onwards.
* Hybrid working that truly works: enjoy a balance of 2\-3 collaborative in\-office days, with the remaining days designed for focused work from home.
* A health insurance plan designed to support your wellbeing and give you peace of mind.
* Premium IT equipment from day one, plus a personal technology budget to help you create a workspace that suits your needs.
* The opportunity to collaborate with colleagues, customers, and partners across the globe in a truly international environment.
* A culture built on trust, autonomy, and ownership, where your ideas are valued, and your contribution makes a visible impact.

  

  

**What success looks like after 12 months**
* You're confidently leading consulting engagements, implementations, and training activities, taking ownership from kickoff to successful delivery.
* Customers trust you to understand their goals, navigate complex challenges, and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes.
* You've built deep expertise in the Bizzdesign platform and Enterprise Architecture, enabling you to provide practical guidance in a wide range of customer scenarios.
* You're a valued partner across Customer Success, Support, Product Development, and Sales, helping drive successful outcomes and trusted relationships.
* Beyond customer projects, you're helping shape how we work by sharing knowledge, improving best practices, and contributing to the continued growth of our Professional Services organization.

  

  

**Recruitment process**  

  

In this role, you can expect the following interviewing process:* 1st Interview with Internal Recruiter (45 minutes)
* 2nd Interview with Professional Services Consultant (60 minutes)
* 3rd Interview with our SVP of Professional Services EMEA (60 minutes)

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
  

**Technical Project Manager — Core Technical Delivery**


Infinite Computer Solutions \| Nokia Business Unit


**Reports To:** Delivery Manager — Nokia Professional Services (practice aligned)
  

**Practice Areas:** IPTEL · Packet Core · SDM (HSS/HLR/UM, SDL) · CSP (Charging, Policy \& Signalling)
  

**Location:** Bangalore / Chennai / Noida
  

**Experience:** 8–15 years in telecom delivery, network operations, managed services or deployment
**Role Purpose**
================


The Technical Project Manager owns the safe, predictable and high\-quality execution of project and live network intervention (LNI) activity within an assigned practice. The role combines genuine technical depth with delivery rigour — every activity executed safely, on time and with zero customer impact.
  

This is a hands\-on role. The TPM is expected to hold the technical command to review a MoP, challenge an implementation approach and lead a critical incident personally — while driving standardisation, automation and a strong engineering culture within the team. The TPM reports to the practice Delivery Manager and is the primary execution owner beneath that layer.
**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**1\. End\-to\-End Delivery Ownership**
---------------------------------------


* Own complete execution of assigned work packages from planning through successful completion.
* Ensure every intervention is delivered safely, within schedule and in compliance with customer standards.
* Drive timely closure of all deliverables while proactively managing risks and dependencies.
* Take accountability for delivery outcomes rather than simply tracking activities.
* Provide the Delivery Manager with accurate, early and unfiltered status — no surprises.

**2\. Work Package Planning \& Ownership**
------------------------------------------


* Allocate work packages to engineers based on competency, certifications and experience.
* Ensure the right engineer is assigned to the right task, with verified readiness.
* Monitor work package progress, remove execution blockers and maintain delivery governance.
* Ensure ownership across the entire lifecycle of each assigned activity.

**3\. Customer Project Alignment**
----------------------------------


* Work closely with customer project managers, planners and technical leads.
* Ensure LNI execution aligns with project timelines, milestones and deployment priorities.
* Represent the execution team during customer governance meetings.
* Build customer confidence through proactive communication and predictable delivery.

**4\. Technical Leadership — Hands On**
---------------------------------------


* Maintain genuine working command of the practice domain — not oversight from a distance.
* Provide technical guidance during planning, execution, rollback and issue resolution.
* Review implementation approaches, Method of Procedure (MoP), rollback plans and risk assessments; approve before execution.
* Lead technical discussions during complex interventions and critical incidents, and drive root cause analysis personally.
* Coach engineers on best practices and promote continuous technical improvement.

**5\. Standardisation**
-----------------------


* Execute against the practice delivery framework — MoP templates, checklists, readiness criteria and acceptance standards — and drive full team adoption.
* Eliminate ad\-hoc, engineer\-specific ways of working; make execution repeatable regardless of who performs it.
* Convert every lesson learned into an updated standard, checklist or preventive control.
* Feed practice\-level gaps and improvement proposals back to the Delivery Manager for framework updates.

**6\. Automation \& Efficiency**
--------------------------------


* Identify repetitive, manual and error\-prone steps within the execution lifecycle and propose automation candidates.
* Drive automation of health checks, pre/post validation, configuration and reporting activities within the team.
* Set and track efficiency targets — effort per work package, cycle time, first\-time\-right percentage.
* Reuse assets from the BU automation repository rather than rebuilding, and contribute back what the team creates.

**7\. Thought Leadership**
--------------------------


* Stay current with technology and tooling direction in the practice domain and bring it into execution practice.
* Propose improvements to delivery approach rather than only executing the defined method.
* Document and share knowledge — playbooks, execution guides, incident learnings — across the wider practice.
* Contribute technical input to solutioning, estimation and proposal work when required.

**8\. Team Management \& People Leadership**
--------------------------------------------


* Build a culture of ownership, accountability and collaboration.
* Conduct regular 1:1s to understand workload, aspirations and challenges.
* Balance shift planning, resource utilisation and fatigue management for 24x7 operations.
* Support hiring, onboarding, mentoring and capability development.

**9\. Inspired Leadership \& Team Motivation**
----------------------------------------------


* Set direction the team believes in — connect day\-to\-day execution to the wider account and customer outcome.
* Foster a positive, high\-performance environment where engineers raise problems early and propose improvements without being asked.
* Recognise individual and team achievement visibly; address underperformance directly and fairly.
* Encourage continuous learning, certification and knowledge sharing.
* Create development plans for engineers to grow into future technical leaders and build a succession bench.

**10\. Quality of Work \& Deliverables**
----------------------------------------


* Ensure every deliverable meets customer quality expectations before submission.
* Drive first\-time\-right execution and eliminate repeat issues.
* Perform quality reviews of documentation, implementation plans and execution reports.
* Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and preventive actions.

**11\. Operational Excellence**
-------------------------------


Ensure consistent adherence to LNI operational standards, including:
* Right engineer for the right task, with validated competency.
* Pre\-LNI readiness verification.
* MoP and rollback validation.
* Network health validation before execution.
* Executor\-Observer compliance.
* Weekly engineer engagement and mentoring.
* Shift and fatigue governance.
* Information Security compliance.
* End\-to\-end ownership of every LNI.
* Same\-day escalation of risks and delivery issues.
* Full adherence to LNI process and governance.

**Key Performance Indicators**
==============================


**Delivery \& Quality** **Compliance \& People**
  

Work Package Delivery Success Rate Quality Audit Compliance
  

On\-Time Delivery (OTD) First Time Right (FTR)
  

Delivery Fulfilment Rate (DFR) Information Security Compliance
  

LNI Success Rate Certification \& Competency Compliance
  

Zero Customer Escalations Team Utilisation \& Productivity
  

Zero Network Impact from execution errors Customer Satisfaction
  

Manual effort automated / standard adoption Employee Engagement and Team Retention
  

**Required Skills**
===================


**Technical**
-------------


* Strong hands\-on understanding of telecom network operations — Core / IP / Cloud preferred.
* Practice domain depth in one or more of IPTEL, Packet Core, SDM or CSP.
* Live network planning and execution.
* Change management; incident and problem management.
* Risk assessment and root cause analysis.
* Network implementation and integration; project delivery.
* Working knowledge of Linux, scripting and automation tooling (Python, Shell, Ansible) sufficient to direct and review automation work.

**Leadership**
--------------


* Team leadership and inspired people management.
* Stakeholder management and customer communication.
* Coaching, mentoring and capability building.
* Decision making under pressure; conflict resolution.
* Planning, prioritisation and delivery governance.
* Personal ownership — takes accountability for outcomes without deflection.

**Preferred Experience**
========================


* 8–15 years in telecom delivery, network operations, managed services or deployment.
* Prior experience within or alongside Nokia delivery organisations.
* Demonstrated automation\-led efficiency improvement with quantified outcomes.
* Relevant certifications — Nokia product certifications, ITIL, PMP, Kubernetes (CKA) or equivalent.

Company Profile:  

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

Job Title: Production support Lead  

Position: Senior Software Engineer/Lead  

Experience: 7 \-12 Years  

Category: Software Development/ Engineering  

Shift: General  

Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai  

Position ID:
  

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 7 years of relevant experience.  

Position Description:
  

  

We are looking for an experienced Production Support / SRE Lead to lead L2/L3 production support operations for a highly available, microservices\-based environment. The role requires strong technical expertise across cloud, container platforms, application technologies, databases, monitoring, automation, and incident management.  

The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and operational excellence of production systems while leading and mentoring a team of production support engineers.  

The candidate should be comfortable navigating multiple technologies and working closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, QA, and business stakeholders to resolve critical production issues and continuously improve platform reliability.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Lead the triage, investigation, and resolution of complex L2/L3 production incidents in a microservices environment while ensuring adherence to SLA/SLO requirements.
* Lead and mentor a team of production support engineers, manage shift rosters, prioritize workloads, and foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and accountability.
* Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability strategies to proactively identify bottlenecks, anomalies, performance issues, and potential system failures.
* Drive detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical P1/P2 incidents and work closely with Development, Architecture, DevOps, and other technical teams to identify permanent fixes and prevent recurrence.
* Promote SRE practices and identify operational toil and repetitive manual activities, driving automation initiatives such as auto\-remediation scripts, automated health checks, monitoring improvements, and operational tooling.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact during major incidents and provide clear, timely, and accurate updates to stakeholders, Delivery Managers, and leadership.
* Collaborate with DevOps and CI/CD teams to support seamless production deployments, blue/green deployments, canary releases, rolling deployments, and zero\-downtime transitions.
* Monitor production systems proactively and identify application, infrastructure, database, and integration\-related issues before they impact customers.
* Analyze system performance, availability, capacity, logs, metrics, and traces to identify and resolve production issues.
* Drive continuous improvement of production support processes, monitoring capabilities, incident response, automation, and system reliability.
* Work across multiple technology stacks and effectively troubleshoot issues involving AWS, OpenShift, Node.js, Python, Java, MongoDB, APIs, microservices, and integrations.
* Ensure proper incident documentation, RCA completion, corrective actions, preventive actions, and knowledge sharing across the support team.
* Participate in production readiness reviews, release validation, capacity planning, disaster recovery activities, and reliability improvement initiatives.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Must Have Skills  

* Strong experience in L2/L3 Production Support within a large\-scale, high\-availability production environment.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS and production troubleshooting in cloud environments.
* Strong experience with OpenShift/Kubernetes and containerized applications.
* Good working knowledge of Node.js, Python, and Java for application troubleshooting and automation.
* Strong experience with MongoDB, including troubleshooting, performance analysis, and production support.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, integrations, service\-to\-service communication, and distributed applications.
* Strong knowledge of Incident Management, Problem Management, Major Incident Management, and Change Management.
* Proven experience handling P1/P2 incidents and driving complex production issues to resolution.
* Strong Root Cause Analysis and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Good understanding of SLA, SLO, SLI, availability, reliability, and performance metrics.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with production deployments, rollback strategies, blue/green deployments, and canary releases.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Node.js, Shell, or similar technologies.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder\-management, and team\-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during critical production incidents.
* Strong ability to navigate and troubleshoot across multiple technologies rather than being limited to a single technology stack.


Good to Have Skills  

* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Elastic Stack, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or similar observability platforms.
* Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
* Experience with Kafka or other messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of API Gateway, service mesh, and distributed tracing.
* Understanding of SRE principles, error budgets, and reliability engineering practices.
* Experience implementing automated health checks and auto\-remediation solutions.
* Knowledge of disaster recovery, high availability, business continuity, and resilience engineering.
* Experience with chaos engineering and resilience testing.
* AWS or Kubernetes/OpenShift certifications.
* Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments.
* Knowledge of application and cloud security practices.

* Develop and maintain an integrated demand roadmap that reflects upcoming initiatives across SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP platforms while maintaining transparency on scope dependencies and expected benefits for all partners.
* Monitor ongoing demand against available capacity for hybrid teams proactively identifying potential bottlenecks over allocations or under utilization and recommending practical mitigation actions.
* Collaborate with finance and portfolio teams to estimate effort cost and expected value for demand items enabling informed investment decisions that support sustainable revenue growth and positive client outcomes.
* Establish and refine demand intake processes templates and review checkpoints so that requests are consistently documented evaluated and approved in a structured and efficient manner.
* Engage with client facing teams and internal business partners to clarify requirements for SFDC TCRM and iPipeline based solutions ensuring that demand accurately reflects regulatory operational and experience needs.
* Partner with GCP engineering and data teams to assess feasibility integration considerations and infrastructure implications for new demand items that involve cloud based data processing and analytics.
* Track demand lifecycle metrics such as lead time cycle time throughput and value realization and present concise insights to management that highlight trends risks and opportunities for improvement.
* Support continuous improvement by analyzing patterns in demand identifying recurring pain points or inefficiencies and proposing pragmatic process or tooling enhancements that increase predictability and quality.
* Guide cross functional workshops and planning sessions in the hybrid model making sure that participants have a shared understanding of scope success criteria and next steps for each prioritized demand item.
* Ensure robust documentation of demand items assumptions dependencies and acceptance criteria so that delivery teams can plan and execute work with reduced ambiguity and rework.
* Align demand management practices with organizational risk compliance and data privacy standards particularly for SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP workloads that handle sensitive customer information.
* Partner with enablement teams to share insights on upcoming demand so that the right skills in SFDC TCRM iPipeline and GCP are developed in advance to meet future portfolio needs.
* Coordinate with operations and support teams to incorporate feedback from production incidents and enhancement requests into the structured demand pipeline in order to improve stability and user satisfaction.
* Influence stakeholders through evidence based recommendations using data and clear reasoning to negotiate priorities manage expectations and drive consensus on trade offs across conflicting needs.
* Ensure effective communication in the hybrid work environment by using collaboration tools and structured updates so that distributed team members remain aligned on active and upcoming demand.


**Qualifications**
* Demonstrate eight to ten years of experience in technology demand management portfolio management or similar roles with significant involvement in enterprise scale application landscapes.
* Show hands on experience working with SFDC TCRM including familiarity with data models analytics features and typical integration patterns used in customer and revenue management scenarios.
* Apply practical experience with iPipeline platforms in insurance or financial services contexts including understanding of workflow document management and digital distribution capabilities.
* Exhibit working knowledge of GCP services relevant to data integration and application hosting so that cloud related demands can be assessed for feasibility cost and alignment with standards.
* Use strong skills in stakeholder communication negotiation and expectation management to bridge business goals and technical execution in a clear and inclusive manner.
* Display proficiency in analyzing quantitative and qualitative data to build forecasts prioritize work identify risks and present concise insights that support decision making.
* Demonstrate capability to operate effectively in a hybrid work model by leveraging collaboration tools maintaining clear documentation and fostering trust across onsite and remote team members.
* Show familiarity with agile and iterative delivery practices so that demand items can be decomposed sequenced and refined to fit within modern delivery frameworks.


**Certifications Required**
 Salesforce certification related to analytics or CRM GCP Associate Cloud Engineer or equivalent cloud certification relevant insurance or financial domain certification is desirable

15\. Provide senior leadership and sales with account updates especially “at risk” accounts
16\. Maintain thorough and consistent customer records via CRM \& other internal systems  

  

**What We’re Looking For:**
01\. Total commitment to learn, improve and be part of our great success story
02\. Minimum of 5\+ years’ experience within a Customer Success, Account Manager or Services team in a like\-minded role.
03\. Experience managing $4m\+ books of business
04\. Significant prior experience defining and implementing success and engagement strategies
05\. Strong leadership skills within the team, across the company, and in managing challenging customer issues.
06\. Strong listening skills
07\. Ability to prioritize accounts based on tiering and manage appropriately.
08\. A customer\-first mindset – you start with the customer and work backwards.

14\. Good project management skills
15\. Highly developed problem solving and negotiation skills
16\. Willing to get creative and be innovative to drive continued success

**Why Everstage?** We're changing how businesses handle sales compensation, and we need a skilled content professional to help us tell that story. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, work with a dynamic team, and grow your skills in a fast\-paced environment.
Join us in creating something amazing!

**Job ID** R\-259609 **Date posted** 09/08/2026

Are you ready to turn complex, cross\-functional processes into streamlined, scalable solutions that free our business to focus on delivering life\-changing medicines? You will partner closely with leaders across functions, applying process mining, automation, and low\-code platforms as tools to diagnose difficulties and implement pragmatic improvements. Automation and Process Mining Assessment: Evaluate and define the scope for automation and process mining, selecting appropriate technologies such as AI, intelligent automation, RPA, and low\-code platforms to solve real business problems.

Change Leadership: Orchestrate change management activities that prepare teams for transition to launch, drive adoption, and embed new ways of working across functions.


Workshop Facilitation: Design and run process discovery workshops with team members at all levels, creating shared understanding and momentum for change.


Project Delivery at Pace: Lead medium to large projects independently or in collaboration with peer experts, balancing multiple initiatives and delivering to agreed timelines and quality.


Standards and Compliance: Apply BPMN 2\.0 for process mapping; ensure solutions follow internal standards, governance, and ethical practices while supporting virtual, global collaboration.


Ways of Working: Contribute to an energised, in\-person culture by engaging on site on average at least three days per week, employing face\-to\-face collaboration to accelerate decisions and outcomes.

* Proven background in delivering end\-to\-end process re\-engineering, optimisation and automation projects, with measurable business outcomes.

* Facilitating process discovery workshops across various stakeholder levels
* Hands\-on Process Mapping experience (no specific tool) using BPMN 2\.0
* Experience in improving service processes going through different functions across organization

* Energetic and self\-motivated
* Strong analytical skills to be able to discover and interpret business requirements
* Critical thinking skills enabling challenging process findings and solutions
* Strong time management skills with ability to work at pace, handling multiple tasks \& projects at one time
* Comfortable with working virtually in a global environment
* Willingness to undertake some domestic/ international travel (as required)

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Significant experience with various related BPM capabilities i.e. AI, Process/Task Mining, Robotics Process Automation, Low Code automation, BPM, workflow tools.
* Experience and proven results in change implementation projects within the Pharma industry
